description: This PHP source file defines the `ProjectActivity` entity class, which models project activities within the OrangeHRM time tracking plugin. It includes properties such as ID, associated project, deletion flag, name, and related timesheet items, along with their getter and setter methods. The class utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and incorporates a decorator trait.

classes.name: ProjectActivity
classes.description: Entity class representing a project activity, with properties for ID, project reference, deletion status, name, and associated timesheet items. Handles database mapping via Doctrine annotations and includes getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the project activity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the project activity.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates this activity with a specific Project entity.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Indicates whether the activity is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the activity as deleted or active.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the project activity.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the project activity.
